title: spring.xxljob
description: Two buckets: spring.xxljob.default holds family-wide values (each overridable per instance), spring.xxljob.instances.<name> holds one entry per named instance. No other key belongs directly under spring.xxljob.

instances.description: One entry per instance; the key is the bean name, and any name is legal.

app-name.description: executor app name, as registered with the admin

log-dir.description: directory served via /log; task log files are written by the application's TaskFunc, not the starter
